title: Custom Cosmetic Packaging Buyer Checklist SourceBridge
buyer_questions: What product dimensions and filled weight should be checked before requesting cosmetic packaging?
Should a skincare jar, serum bottle or gift set use an insert, tray or divider?
Which surface finish direction fits retail, ecommerce and launch-kit use?
Which RFQ fields should a buyer prepare before asking for a custom cosmetic packaging quote?
rfq_fields: Product size, weight and packed orientation
Jar, bottle, palette, kit or set structure
Insert, tray, divider and protection requirement
Retail channel, ecommerce path and launch use
Artwork status, brand color and finish direction
Target market and any document-review requirement
domestic_competitor_takeaway: Chinese export factory sites usually make product category and quote entry visible; MUGE should keep cosmetic packaging RFQ entry close to the product decision section.
overseas_competitor_takeaway: Overseas packaging sites use buyer guides, comparison language and sustainability/resource framing; MUGE should answer fit, material and structure questions before asking for RFQ.
avoid_points: Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price.
Do not claim food-contact suitability, destination-market compliance or certification without document review.
Do not present unverified customer cases, factory scale, partnerships or platform badges as facts.
counting_boundary: This SourceBridge is public source-routing and buyer education evidence only. It is not proof of Google ranking, GSC clicks, GA4 traffic, AI natural recommendation, inquiry generation, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or fixed price.
